data.action: 微侧身双手交叉轻护胸口，泪眼汪汪满面通红
data.animaCaption: Caught mid-change beside a wooden folding screen in white satin undergarments and sheer thigh-highs, she presses both hands over her chest with teary eyes and a bright crimson blush.
data.description: 彩色花窗投光更衣屏风旁，正在更换礼服的菲比仅着白丝缎带抹胸与蕾丝过膝袜，察觉视线后慌张用双手护住胸口，耳根通红。
data.lighting: 彩窗柔和漫射光映照白丝缎面光泽
data.location: 圣堂侧厅彩窗更衣屏风旁
data.promptProse: Beside a carved wooden screen in the sacristy dressing room, Phoebe freezes in an ivory satin bandeau bra, bow-trimmed panties, and white thigh-high stockings, crossing her hands over her chest in a flustered blush.
data.title: 菲比 · 更衣屏风后白丝缎带内衣慌张遮掩
